title: To-Do List
description: Complete a Pug template for a Node.js to-do list app that displays tasks, adds new tasks through a form, and clears the list when requested.

instructions.studentPrompt: In this lab, you will write the Pug code for managing a list of to-do items. The lab contains a Node.js project composed of several files: - public/styles.css - The app's external stylesheet - views/index.pug - Pug file that displays the app's only webpage - server.js - Express server that stores to-do items in the todoList array and implements three routes: - GET route to "/" renders index.pug, passing the todoList as a local - POST route to "/new" adds a new item to todoList and redirects the browser back to the "/" route - GET route to "/clear" removes all items from todoList and redirects the browser back to the "/" route Only index.pug needs to be completed. Step 1: Show the list Implement the index.pug file to show an unordered list of the items in the todoList local. Use Pug's each loop to create the unordered list. The todoList local is initialized in server.js with two items, so the unordered list should initially show two items. Ensure that index.pug uses proper HTML structure and includes the following elements: - that reads "To-Do List" - <link> that imports styles.css - <h1> at the top of the page that reads "To-Do List" Step 2: Add to the list Add a <form> above the list that posts to the path "/new". The form should have an <input> for entering a to-do item and a submit <button> that reads "Add". When the form is working properly, added items are displayed at the bottom of the list. Step 3: Clear the list Add an <a> with link text "Clear" that links to the path "/clear". When clicked, the list should disappear. Add a Pug if-else conditional to show a <p> that reads "Enter some tasks." when todoList is empty. Else the list should be displayed.

files.notes: The raw source later labels this block as style.css, but the assignment file list and server.js static setup establish the project file as public/styles.css while the rendered <link> href remains styles.css.

files.content:
doctype 
html(lang='en')
   head
   title To-Do List
   link(rel='stylesheet' href='styles.css')
   body
      h1 To-Do List

      form(method='post' action='/new')
         input(type='text' name='item' autofocus='')
         button Add

      if todoList.length == 0
         p Enter some tasks.
      else
         ul
            each item in todoList
               li= item
         a(href='/clear') Clear

validation: Reject explanatory text outside the Pug file.
Require the exact editable file path views/index.pug.
Compile the submitted Pug before running tests.

tests.name: Page structure and title
Displays to-do list items
Add-task form
Empty-list message
Clear-list link
